summary: 168 items audited. Coverage of mainstream Western/Indian/Mexican/Japanese spices is strong, and form (whole vs ground) is correctly handled as a per-item `facets` axis (form: ground/whole/stick/threads) with `defaultSelections` rather than duplicate items, so there are NO whole-vs-ground duplicate rows to merge. Parent/child is used well for varietals (saffron->iranian/kashmiri/afghan, cinnamon->ceylon/cassia/saigon/korintje, paprika->hungarian/spanish, peppercorn->tellicherry/malabar/etc, salt->kosher/sea/etc, chili powder/flakes->regional chiles, furikake/togarashi/grill-seasoning families). Main weaknesses: (1) notable GLOBAL gaps in dried blends and single spices that recipes worldwide call for: smoked paprika, herbes de Provence, baharat, dukkah, harissa powder, advieh, hawaij, panch phoron, quatre epices, tandoori/tikka/sambar/rasam/vindaloo masalas, kasoori methi (dried fenugreek leaves), kala namak, fleur de sel/flaky finishing salts, gomashio, dashi powder, mahleb, dried barberry, dried rose, plus East African staples (pilau masala, suya spice, peri-peri/pilipili, mchuzi mix) and lesser herbs (sorrel, lovage, hyssop, borage, savoury greens, fennel pollen, dried lemongrass, perilla/sansho, ground/dried ginger & galangal as a spice form); (2) a handful of bad aliases (spanish-paprika -> 'spanish saffron'; dried-orange-peel -> 'orange zest'; the overly generic 'herbs'/'fresh herbs'/'mixed herbs' on the herb-grill-seasoning row); (3) wild-szechuan-peppercorn duplicates every alias of its own parent szechuan-peppercorn (alias collision); (4) a few odd freshness ranges (herb grill seasoning Pantry [1,3]). Note: ginger, galangal, garlic, onion, shallot, chive, scallion, lemongrass, tamarind, horseradish, fresh poppy/nigella seed, kombu/nori/wakame and curry/chili pastes already live in Produce / Nuts & Seeds / Condiments, so they are intentionally NOT re-proposed here except as distinct DRIED-SPICE forms (ground ginger, dried lemongrass) that belong in this category.
issues: Form is a facet, not a separate item: e.g. cumin/cinnamon/peppercorn/saffron/garam-masala each carry facets.form = [ground, whole, ...] with defaultSelections. Good design; means proposals must NOT add whole/ground twins.

Several IDs are truncated to a non-descriptive single token: herb (herb grill seasoning), sea (sea salt), summer/winter (savory), meco/morita (chipotle), nanami (togarashi), shiso/wasabi/salmon/nori (furikake), holy/genovese/lemon (basil), california/indian/turkish (bay leaf), hungarian (paprika), afghan/iranian/kashmiri (saffron). They function via parentIds but are fragile and collide conceptually (e.g. 'spanish' id is used by spanish adobo sauce, not spanish paprika).

herb-grill-seasoning carries the bare aliases 'herbs', 'fresh herbs', 'mixed herbs' and a Pantry freshness of [1,3] days — these generic aliases will wrongly capture any 'herbs' mention, and the 1-3 day pantry shelf life is almost certainly a data error.
spanish-paprika has alias 'spanish saffron' — saffron is a different spice; this is a copy/paste error.
dried-orange-peel lists 'orange zest' as an alias; fresh orange zest is a produce item, not a dried pantry spice — likely to mis-match.
Coverage gap: NO smoked paprika despite 'spanish paprika' / 'hungarian paprika' children existing (smoked pimenton is one of the most-called-for paprikas worldwide).
Coverage gap: classic European/Mediterranean dried blends missing — herbes de Provence, quatre epices, dukkah, baharat, za'atar exists but no dukkah/baharat.

Coverage gap: Indian masalas thin — has garam masala/chaat masala/curry-powder family but missing tandoori masala, tikka masala, sambar powder, rasam powder, vindaloo, panch phoron, kasoori methi (dried fenugreek leaves, distinct from fenugreek seed).

Coverage gap: African spices underrepresented for an app targeting Kenya/Morocco — has berbere, ras el hanout, moroccan-spice-blend but no pilau masala, suya spice, peri-peri/pilipili, mchuzi mix, harissa powder.
Coverage gap: finishing/specialty salts limited (kosher/sea/himalayan/celtic) but no fleur de sel, Maldon/flaky, kala namak (black salt), smoked salt as its own row (currently only a salt facet).
wild-szechuan-peppercorn and szechuan-peppercorn share an identical alias set, so an input string resolves ambiguously between parent and child.
redundancies: Child copies the parent's entire alias list ('sichuan pepper', 'hua jiao', 'chinese peppercorn', etc.) so the two are indistinguishable by alias; child should keep only wild-specific aliases (e.g. 'wild sichuan pepper', 'timur') or be merged as a facet/variant.

aleppo chili flakes is a child of chili-flakes; fine as a varietal, but 'crushed red pepper'/'red pepper flakes' generic aliases live on the parent while aleppo/gochugaru/urfa are siblings — acceptable, flagged only as a parent/child review point, not a true dup.

Not a redundancy to merge — coriander (seed/Spices) and cilantro (fresh leaf/Refrigerated) are correctly separate items; noted because coriander's aliases include 'cilantro seed' and cilantro's include 'coriander leaves', which is the right disambiguation. No action.

newItems.name: smoked paprika
newItems.notes: Spain (La Vera); oak-smoked dried peppers; staple of chorizo, paella, romesco. Major gap given sweet/hot paprika are covered.

newItems.name: herbes de Provence
newItems.notes: Southern France; thyme/rosemary/savory/marjoram/oregano (+lavender). Core French blend, explicitly named in task.

newItems.name: baharat
newItems.notes: Gulf/Levant; black pepper, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, paprika. Explicitly named in task.

newItems.name: dukkah
newItems.notes: Egypt; toasted nuts (hazelnut/almond) + sesame, coriander, cumin. Contains nuts -> NOT Nut-Free; shorter shelf life due to nut oils.

newItems.name: advieh
newItems.notes: Iran; rose petal, cardamom, cinnamon, cumin, turmeric. Used in Persian rice and stews.

newItems.name: hawaij
newItems.notes: Yemen; savory version = cumin/turmeric/black pepper/cardamom/coriander; coffee version = cardamom/ginger/cinnamon.

newItems.name: panch phoron
newItems.notes: Bengal/Eastern India; whole equal-parts fenugreek, nigella, cumin, black mustard, fennel. Always used whole -> longer shelf life.

newItems.name: quatre epices
newItems.notes: France; pepper, clove, nutmeg, ginger (sometimes cinnamon). Charcuterie, terrines, pates.

newItems.name: tandoori masala
newItems.notes: North India; cumin, coriander, paprika/Kashmiri chili, garam masala base for tandoori marinades.

newItems.name: tikka masala
newItems.notes: Indian/British; dry spice blend for tikka masala (distinct from the cooked sauce).

newItems.name: sambar powder
newItems.notes: South India; roasted lentils, coriander, fenugreek, dried chili, curry leaf for sambar.

newItems.name: rasam powder
newItems.notes: South India; pepper, cumin, coriander, dried chili for rasam soup.

newItems.name: vindaloo masala
newItems.notes: Goa, India; Portuguese-influenced fiery blend with Kashmiri chili, cumin, vinegar/garlic notes.

newItems.name: kasoori methi
newItems.notes: India; dried fenugreek LEAVES (an herb) — distinct from fenugreek SEED already in catalog; finishing aroma for curries, naan.

newItems.name: harissa powder
newItems.notes: Tunisia/North Africa; dry version of harissa (chili, caraway, coriander, cumin, garlic). Paste form lives in Condiments; dry spice belongs here.

newItems.name: pilau masala
newItems.notes: Kenya/Swahili coast; cumin, coriander, cardamom, cinnamon, clove, black pepper, bay. Core East African rice blend.

newItems.name: suya spice
newItems.notes: Nigeria/West Africa; ground peanut (kuli kuli) + chili, ginger, paprika, bouillon. Contains peanut -> NOT Nut-Free.

newItems.name: pilipili spice
newItems.notes: Southern/East Africa & Portugal; African bird's-eye chili based dry seasoning.

newItems.name: mchuzi mix
newItems.notes: Kenya/East Africa; packaged curry-style stew seasoning. Common in Kenyan home cooking.

newItems.name: shawarma seasoning
newItems.notes: Levant/Middle East; cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom for shawarma.

newItems.name: adobo seasoning
newItems.notes: Latin America/Caribbean; garlic, oregano, black pepper, turmeric, salt. Dry all-purpose seasoning (distinct from adobo sauce in Condiments).

newItems.name: everything bagel seasoning
newItems.notes: USA; sesame, poppy, dried garlic/onion, salt. Ubiquitous modern blend.

newItems.name: gomashio
newItems.notes: Japan; toasted sesame + salt condiment. Contains sesame; left Nut-Free off out of caution for shared allergen handling.

newItems.name: dashi powder
newItems.notes: Japan; powdered kombu/bonito stock base. Bonito version contains fish -> NOT Vegan/Vegetarian (kombu-only version would be).

newItems.name: ground ginger
newItems.notes: Global; the dried-spice form of ginger (fresh ginger is in Produce). Baking, masalas, gingerbread.

newItems.name: kala namak
newItems.notes: South Asia; sulfurous rock salt used in chaat and vegan egg dishes.

newItems.name: fleur de sel
newItems.notes: France (Guerande/Brittany); hand-harvested finishing salt.

newItems.name: flaky sea salt
newItems.notes: UK (Maldon) etc.; pyramidal finishing flakes. Currently only a 'flaky' facet on salt; deserves its own commonly-named row.

newItems.name: mahleb
newItems.notes: Levant/Greece/Turkey; ground St Lucie cherry kernels; aromatic baking spice for breads (tsoureki, ka'ak).

newItems.name: dried barberry
newItems.notes: Iran; tart dried berries used in zereshk polo and Persian rice.

newItems.name: dried rose petals
newItems.notes: Middle East/Persia/India; in advieh, ras el hanout, garnishes, desserts.

newItems.name: dried lemongrass
newItems.notes: SE Asia; dried/ground spice form (fresh lemongrass stalk is in Produce). Curry pastes, teas, rubs.

newItems.name: sansho pepper
newItems.notes: Japan; citrusy-numbing relative of Sichuan pepper; on unagi, in shichimi.

newItems.name: sorrel
newItems.notes: Europe; tart culinary herb for soups/sauces. (Distinct from hibiscus 'sorrel' drink.)

newItems.name: lovage
newItems.notes: Europe; celery-like herb for stocks, soups, central/eastern European cooking.

newItems.name: hyssop
newItems.notes: Mediterranean/Levant; minty-bitter herb, also a za'atar component in some regions.

newItems.name: fennel pollen
newItems.notes: Italy/Mediterranean; intense aromatic finishing spice for porchetta, sausages.

newItems.name: annatto powder
newItems.notes: Latin America/Philippines; ground annatto for color (cochinita pibil, sazon). Complements existing annatto-seed and achiote-paste.

newItems.name: garlic granules
newItems.notes: Coarser dried-garlic form; widely specified separately from fine garlic powder in rubs/blends.

newItems.name: dried minced onion
newItems.notes: Flaked dried onion (vs fine onion powder); soup mixes, everything seasoning.

newItems.name: dried porcini powder
newItems.notes: Italy/global; umami seasoning powder ground from dried mushrooms. (Whole dried mushrooms are in Produce.)

newItems.name: chile de arbol
newItems.notes: Mexico; common dried/ground chile alongside existing ancho/guajillo/pasilla children.

newItems.name: kashmiri chili powder
newItems.notes: India; mild, deeply red chili powder essential to North Indian/tandoori color.

newItems.name: tajin
newItems.notes: Mexico; chili-lime-salt seasoning for fruit, snacks, rims.

newItems.name: goda masala
newItems.notes: Maharashtra, India; 'sweet' dark masala with coconut, sesame, stone flower (dagad phool).

newItems.name: vadouvan
newItems.notes: French-Indian (Pondicherry); curry blend with dried onion/garlic, fenugreek.

cleanups.fix: Remove the alias 'spanish saffron' (wrong spice; saffron is unrelated). Optionally add correct aliases 'pimenton dulce', 'spanish sweet paprika'.

Trim aliases so it no longer copies the parent szechuan-peppercorn's full set ('chinese peppercorn', 'hua jiao', 'sichuan pepper', 'sichuan peppercorn', 'szechuan peppercorns'); keep only wild-specific terms like 'wild sichuan pepper', 'timur pepper' to remove the parent/child alias collision.
Remove generic alias 'orange zest' (fresh produce term that collides with citrus zest); keep 'dried orange zest', 'dried orange peels'.

Remove the over-broad aliases 'herbs', 'fresh herbs', 'mixed herbs' from herb-grill-seasoning (they swallow any 'herbs' input); and review the Pantry freshness [1,3] days which looks like a data error (a dried grill seasoning should be ~[180,365]).
Remove the bare alias 'mexican' (too generic; will match unrelated 'mexican ...' inputs); keep 'oregano mexicano', 'lippia graveolens', 'dried mexican oregano'.
Alias 'flavor enhancer 621' is fine; consider normalizing 'monosodium glutamate powder' (redundant with name).
Non-descriptive id 'afghan' for afghan saffron; consider renaming id to 'afghan-saffron' for consistency with siblings iranian/kashmiri (low priority, cosmetic).
Non-descriptive id 'sea' for sea salt; consider 'sea-salt' (cosmetic, parentIds already wires it to salt).
